section-projects.client-projects-descrip: At Damocle'Sword, we have a specialized department that offers services to other companies looking to integrate virtual reality into their business objectives. We contact them, provide a proposal tailored to their specific needs, and then carry out the project for them.
section-vision.business-talk:
We envision ourselves as a company willing to do whatever it takes to create an excellent work environment that brings out the best in each of our members and reflects it in our VR games. 

With our talent, effort, and love for video games, we will create a full range of the highest quality VR video games.
section-contact.keep-contact-description: Give us your email and receive information about our developments to participate in testing and more.
section-contact.help-us-description: Become a member of our Patreon and actively support the development of our VR games.
